title: Continua, arcs and cut points
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: Locally connected continua from the definitions to dendrites, with complete proofs: connected open subsets of a locally connected complete metric space are path connected; every path between two points contains an arc between them; the first Čech cohomology group of a compact metric space by finite covers, with the working form of its vanishing, the circle, retracts and closed subsets in dimension at most one; and the theorem that a Peano continuum of dimension at most one with vanishing first Čech cohomology is a dendrite and so has cut points. This is the last step of OpenAI's proof (2026) of the Singer conjecture in dimension four in degrees other than two, and the topological input of that proof which the course writes out in full.
prerequisites: core course Point-Set Topology (C90): compactness, connectedness, complete metric spaces
covering dimension: Definition 2.1 and Theorems 3.2, 4.2 of the lesson Covering dimension and finite trivializing covers (course Index theory of elliptic operators)
the course proves every other fact it uses
